results.title: Delhi High Court rejects plea to remove Additional DCP Sandeep Lamba who slapped woman protester
results.description: The Delhi High Court dismissed a petition seeking to remove Additional DCP Sandeep Lamba from supervising a court-directed police inquiry. The plea cited a viral video that purportedly showed Lamba slapping a woman during the Chalo Jantar Mantar protest. The court said allegations alone could not justify a presumption of bias without a fair trial.
